services.name: Student Field Trips
services.desc: Exploring the headwaters of the Florida Everglades and learning about native and exotic animals from all over the world is exciting and fun. Wild Florida Adventure Park is the perfect place to explore those concepts learned in a classroom by putting them into practice in a real setting. Educational field trips in Florida provide students with a unique opportunity to delve into the fascinating world of wildlife, both native to our state and from across the globe. These excursions are meticulously designed to impart valuable knowledge about the diverse species that inhabit our planet. services.name: airboat ride
services.desc: Whether it’s your first or 50th, there’s something about Orlando airboat tours that make you want to shout, “Again!”Locals and tourists alike travel to Wild Florida Adventure Park to experience our Central Florida Everglades airboat tours as it provides a unique way of seeing Florida’s native wildlife and the beauty of nature up close. Our Orlando airboat rides are a great way to experience Central Florida from a fresh perspective and will give you a chance to see the real Florida and trek through a nature preserve that’s home to a number of animals and plants that make up the Florida Everglades ecosystem. Take a thrilling ride on an airboat through the Headwaters of the Florida Everglades.

services.name: Package
services.desc: Ever wanted to feed a giraffe, chill with a sloth, or meet the world's largest rodent (spoiler: it's the capybara)? At Wild Florida, our animal encounters let you get closer than ever to the wild side. These hands-on experiences go beyond just photo ops (though we're definitely fans of a good #slothie). Whether you're a family looking for something unforgettable, a wildlife lover, or just someone ready to shake up their Florida trip, this is your chance to make it wild. services.name: petting zoo
services.desc: From two-toed sloths and capybaras to African-crested porcupines and ring-tailed lemurs, our animal encounters let you connect with some of Wild Florida Adventure Parks’s friendliest residents. Whether you’re snapping a “slothie” or dancing with porcupines, these once-in-a-lifetime experiences are the perfect way to add a little extra wild to your visit. Come meet Wild Florida’s capybaras and experience their sweet, social nature for yourself! Plus, Wild Florida Adventure Park now offers capybara encounters at 4 PM.
